name: Vortex
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range. On a win, their speed is reduced to 0 for 1 round. On a loss, same as on a win, but the creature may spend a half action to end the effect.

If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled, you may instead target a creature within long range, and on a loss, the creature must spend an action to end the effect.

Describe the vortex you create.
successes:
✨: The target cannot make attacks or cast spells that require physical movement.

✨: The target drops an object it's wielding, chosen at random.

🌞: On a win, at the end of the round, repeat the roll against the same target. On a win, reapply the effect. On a loss, the effect ends. Repeat this each round until the spell ends.
